_comment: default - the stock icons, byte for byte.
An empty ops list means copy the baseline verbatim rather than decode and
re-encode. That is the whole point of this theme: `tdtheme apply default`
has to be a true reset, and every other theme carries a complete icon set,
so the only way back to stock is to put the shipped bytes back exactly.
Do not add ops here. This file documents the absence of icon theming; a
theme that wants tinted icons wants its own name.
tdtheme apply default      # stock colours, stock options, stock icons
